# orbivisor_floating_ip (Resource)

A floating IP on an external network, optionally pointing at a VM NIC.

Manifest kind `FloatingIp`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.
- `network` (String) External network name.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address (empty: the server picks one).
- `description` (String)
- `folder` (String) Folder path (`/prod/web`); empty is the tree's root. Changing it replaces the object (move it with `orbivisorctl folder move` and change the path here instead).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `target` (Dynamic) Target, e.g. `{ vm = "web01", nic = 0 }`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
